verdict.rationale: GitLab's marketing docs claim AI 'agents' can turn issues into merge requests, remediate vulnerabilities, and review code, and that security findings surface in MRs/IDEs, which implies AI-generated insights/suggestions embedded in the workflow. However, all evidence is thin, high-level marketing language from about.gitlab.com with no deeper documentation of specific insight types (e.g., vulnerability explanations, code suggestions rationale) and no independent or hands-on corroboration of these AI features actually working. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on specific AI-insight features (Duo Chat/Code Suggestions specifics), independent/hands-on validation of insight quality, and concrete examples of AI-generated suggestions in practice.
